# romp

> Physics-baked character motion, a motion check and synthesised sound for videos made in code: Remotion, three.js or any page with a seek(t), played live on requestAnimationFrame or rendered frame by frame. TypeScript, MIT.

Install from GitHub (not on npm yet): `bun add github:isaacrowntree/romp planck`. The CLI also needs `esbuild` and `playwright`. Docs: https://isaacrowntree.com/romp/ · Source: https://github.com/isaacrowntree/romp

## romp/core
- `new Stage({ pxPerMetre?, gravity?, yDown? })`: one planck.js (Box2D) world. `ground(points, { layer? })`, `add(actor)` (sets `actor.stage`, calls `build`), `bake({ frames | duration, fps?, hz? = 240 })` once, `pose(t)` calls each actor's `apply(pose, t)` (NaN poses arrive as `{ shown: false }`), `get(id)`.
- Actor protocol: `build(stage)`, `control?(t, dt)`, `sample(t)` → pose, `apply?(pose, t)`.
- `Body({ id, x, y (feet), w, h, shape?, spawn?, vx?, vy?, spin?, restitution?, upright?, layer?, mask?, gravityScale? })`: records `impacts` `{ frame, t, speed, vx }`; `landed`.
- `SpringyBody({ ...Body, ground, groundY, hz?, damping? })`: welds where it first lands on `ground`; knocked over, it wobbles back.
- `Drop({ ...Body, foot?, ledge?, frame?, spinAt?, tilt?, z?: [from, to], rock? })`: upright drop; `flight(frame)` → `{ u, spin, tilt, z, rockDir }` (all at rest at touchdown); `framePose(frame)`.
- `Leap({ id, x, y, vx, vy, surface, size?, spawn?, gravity?, frame? })`: ballistic leap through a surface; `crossings`.
- `poseAt(actor, frame, { discrete?: "nearest" | "previous" })`, `poseAtTime(actor, seconds, fps?, opts?)`, `baked(key, build)`, `LAYER`.
- Motion: `impactResponse(body, frame, seed?)` → `{ squashX, squashY, tilt, lift, blink, jiggle }`; `jiggle(dt, strength)`; `jiggleParts(parts, dt, strength?, lag?)`; `landing`, `hop`, `idle`, `blinkAt`, `boing`, `rock`, `nearImpact`; curves `ease`, `spring`, `ringOut`, `stagger`, `SPRING`.
- `Clock({ seek, duration, loop?, audio?, onPlay?(t), onStop?() })`: live playback; follows the AudioContext clock while sound plays. `play(from?)`, `pause()`, `seek(t)`.

## romp/check
- `analyze(frames, { fps?, width?, height?, whips?, covered?, impacts?, seamless?, croppedFraction?, croppedSeconds?, allowCrop?, lostSeconds?, allowExit? })` → `{ tracked, frames, issues }`. Issues: pop (appears/vanishes in frame at ≥30% of its largest size, opaque), strobe (> ~100 px per frame at 886 px wide), teleport (> ~300 px), jump (> ~40 px in one frame between still frames, `jumpPx`; not at a scene cut), spike (acceleration far above its neighbours'), cropped (more than 25% of its box outside the frame for more than 0.5 s, not while entering or leaving; needs width and height; a `screen` or `focus` that fits in the frame: 1%, `screenCroppedFraction`; a sample's numeric `allowCrop` is its own share). Exempt: impacts, whips, covered frames, fades/grows, seamless, allowCrop.
- `formatReport(report, fps?)`, `collectDom(root)` (every `[data-romp]` element, with its box), `inFrameShare(box, W, H)`.
- Layout: blank (nothing tracked visible, or only `role: "background"`, > 0.5 s outside covered; `blankSeconds`; on once anything has a role, or strict), clipped (a screen's `clip`, what overflow-hidden ancestors leave, under 99% of its in-frame box > 0.5 s; `allowCrop` exempts), occupancy (opt-in `occupancy: true | share | { share, seconds }`: tracked boxes cover < 20% of the frame > 2 s; `unionShare`). legibility also covers `role: "text"` with `fontPx` (font-size × on-screen scale) under `textPx` (20 px at a 1080 short side). overlap: a text on a screen's content (either on top) > 0.2 s unless the text is `opaque` (solid background of its own). `layoutOnly: true` (sampled frames) runs only cropped, offsafe, covers, overlap, legibility, anchor, clipped, blank, occupancy.
- Screens and anchors: legibility (a `role: "screen"` sample with `native: { width }` drawn so its body text, `minTextPx` 16 native px × rendered scale, is under `legiblePx`, 20 px at a 1080 short side, for > 0.5 s; zooming is fine), anchor (a text with `ground` y shows below it; one with `anchor` (a tracked name) is > `anchorPx`, 10% of the short side, from it > 0.1 s). `boxGap(a, b)`. Report `warnings` (strict CLI: untracked surfaces and plain text over a tracked text or screen; `--untracked error` makes them `untracked` issues); `untrackedOver(root)` → `{ what, size, text, kind }[]`. Only `[data-romp]` elements are seen: props drawn inside one svg/canvas are invisible; track each.
- Text rules, for samples with `role: "text" | "focus" | "prop"` (text: `text?`, `words?`, `chars?: { shown, total }`, `heading?`; any: `z?`, `allow?`): offsafe (a legible text outside the safe area for > 0.1 s; `safeArea(W, H)`: 5% of the long side at its ends, 3.5% of the short side), covers (a text over the focus box > 0.1 s), overlap (two texts > 0.2 s, or a prop drawn over a text for 2 frames, `propOverlapSeconds`; a prop with lower `z` is a backdrop), unfinished (gone, or its scene cut, before every character shows), unread (whole for less than `readingTime`), empty (a box with no words > 0.2 s, or a heading still typing 0.5 s after it appears), stale (strict or `stale: true`: nothing changes > 3 s after the words were read). Options: `scenes` (cuts, seconds), `strict`, `safe`, `offsafeSeconds`, `coversFraction`, `coversSeconds`, `overlapFraction`, `overlapSeconds`, `emptySeconds`, `headingSeconds`, `reading: { wpm, min }`, `stale`, `allow: { kind: names (trailing * = prefix) }`. Off for objects without a role.

## romp/timing
- `readingTime(text | words, { wpm = 180, min = 1.5 })` seconds; `wordCount(text)`.
- `captionTiming(text, { cps = 30, hold?, enter?, exit?, fps? })` → `{ chars, words, enterFrames, typeFrames, holdFrames, exitFrames, totalFrames, typed(frame) }`.
- `timeline(scenes, { fps, transition = 0.5, actSeconds = 1.2, gap, lead, tail, cps })`: scenes `{ name, captions?, seconds?, act?, transition? }` → `{ frames, scenes (start, frames incl. transitions, transitionIn/Out, captions { text, from, to, at, timing }), check: { covered, scenes, sections: { name, from, to } } }`; transitions never land on a caption's reading window. `captionAt(caption, frame)` → `{ on, typed, text }`.

## romp/remotion
- `track(name, { impact?, seamless?, allowCrop? (boolean | share), allowExit?, role?, allow?, z?, anchor?, ground? })` → data attributes for `romp check`. `trackScreen(name, nativeWidth, { minTextPx? })` → a screen for the legibility rule. `track(name, { opaque })`; `role: "background"`.
- `trackText(name, text, { typed?, heading?, ... })` → a text for the text rules (`data-romp-role`, `-text`, `-chars-shown`, `-chars-total`, `-heading`). `sceneSequence(scene)` → `{ from, durationInFrames, name }`. Re-exports `captionTiming`, `captionAt`, `timeline`, `readingTime`.
- `trackBurst(name, particles, opts?)` → props for an empty element covering a particle burst (centred where it comes from): the check follows the burst as one object.

## romp/three
- `motionReport({ seek, scene, camera, fps, W, H, from?, to?, whips?, covered? })` (userData: impacts, seamless, allowCrop), `screenBox`, `screenArea`, `opacityOf`.

## romp/audio
- `Synth` (voices: marimba, bell, whoosh, tap, splash, riser, thump, click, engine, reverb…), `Instruments` (pluck, kick, shaker, rhodes, piano, upright, rim, brush), `createMix(synth, { levels?, sends?, room? })` → buses music/drums/sfx/voice/master.
- A `Schedule` is `(synth, buses, at) => void`; `at(filmSeconds)` → context time or null (already played).
- `renderOffline(schedule, { duration, extend? })` → AudioBuffer; `renderWav(...)` → base64 WAV; `playLive(ctx, schedule, { from?, extend? })` → `{ origin, stop() }`. `fitTo`, `midiHz`, `rng`, `wavBase64`, `LEAD` (1/30 s).
- `listen(schedule, { extend? })` → `Score`: runs a synchronous schedule silently and records every voice it plays (outermost call only) as `{ t, end, voice, bus, vel, midi?, shape: hit|swell|bed }`. `score.envelopeAt(t, { bus?, voice?, decay? })` (sum of levels through each event's shape), `score.beatAt(t, filter = { bus: "drums" })` → `{ index, phase, since, t0, t1 }`, `score.onsetsBetween(t0, t1, filter?)`, `score.select(filter)`. Pure functions of film time: audio-reactive visuals without a live analyser.
- `dropouts(audio, { min = 0.1, max = 1, drop = 30 dB, floor?, window?, around? })` → `{ t, duration, level, bed }[]`: near-silence inside a continuous bed; `readWav(bytes)`, `rmsWindows`, `formatDropouts`. `crossfadeBed(synth, out, sections { from, to, write(out, t0, t1) }, { fade = 0.5 })`: one bed with equal-power crossfades at every join, no gaps.
- `romp/audio/cartoon`: `cartoon` (extend with plop, boing, babble, slurp, beep, ding, tock, pip, swish, scribble) and `VOICES`.

## romp/particles
- `new Emitter({ id?, seed?, fps? = 30, at? (frame), count? | rate? + until?, x?, y?, area?, direction? = -π/2, spread? = 2π, speed?, gravity? = 1200, wind?, drag?, sway?, swayHz?, life?, size?, spin?, flip?, colors?, shapes?, grow? = 0.08, fadeIn?, fadeOut? = 0.3, shrink?, align?, stretch?, ground?, bounce? = 0.3, friction? = 0.6 })`. Ranges are a number or [min, max]; px, seconds, radians (screen space). `emitter.particlesAt(frame)` → `{ i, emitter, x, y, x0, y0, vx, vy, angle, size, length, flip, opacity, color, shape, age, life, resting }[]`, a pure function of the frame (seeded hash per particle index, closed-form flight; bounces on `ground` found once per particle). `emitter.span`, `emitter.count`.
- `particlesAt(emitters, frame)`; presets (options to spread/override) `confetti`, `sparks`, `snow({ width, height?, until })`, `fountain`; `particleStyle(p)` (inline CSS), `drawParticles(ctx, ps)` (canvas), `particleBox(p)`, `particleBounds(ps)`, `particleSample(ps, frame?)` (a burst as one motion-check sample, centred on where it comes from), `hash01(seed, i, k)`.
- Motion check: particles grow in and fade out by default (not pops); single sparks can be strobes, so track the burst (`trackBurst` / `particleSample`), not each particle.

## romp/theatre (Theatre.js; no import of @theatre/core)
- `seekSequence(sequence, seek?)` → `(t) => void` (moves the playhead, then seek(t)); `followSequence(sequence, onChange, seek, rafDriver?)` → unsubscribe (pass `onChange` from @theatre/core).
- `objectSample(value, { size?, frame? })`, `objectsRow(objects, opts)` (reads x, y / position, opacity, scale, width, height, visible); `theatreFrames(o)`, `theatreReport({ sequence, collect, to, from?, fps?, seek?, ...AnalyzeOptions })`.

## romp/motion-canvas (no import of @motion-canvas/*)
- `yield* playBaked((t) => …, { duration, time?: useTime, fps? })`; `centred(pose, W, H)` → `{ position, rotation (deg) }` for a centre-origin view.
- `motionCanvasReport({ seek: (f) => player.playback.seek(f), nodes: () => byKey(view, keys), fps, width, height, to, from? })` → Promise<Report>; `byKey`, `nodeSample`, `nodesRow`.

## romp/lottie (lottie-web; no import)
- `lottieReport(anim, { layers?, from?, to?, ...AnalyzeOptions })` (fps/size from the animation), `lottieFrames`, `collectLottie`. Steps `goToAndStop(f, true)`; layers by AE name, precomp layers "Precomp/Layer"; transforms through parents and precomps; null and matte layers skipped. A layer cut in at full size is a pop.

## CLI
- `romp check <entry.tsx> [--public dir] [--from s] [--to s] [--arg json] [--strict] [--audio file.wav] [--json]`: plays a Remotion composition in headless Chromium, every frame; exit 1 on any issue (motion, text, audio). The entry default-exports `{ component, props?, durationInFrames, fps, width, height, ...analyze options }` or a function of `--arg` returning one. `--strict`: untagged tracked objects are props for overlap, stale runs, and untracked svg/canvas/img/video drawn over a text are warned about.
- `romp check` flags: `--jobs N` (pages to shard across, default half the cores ≤ 8; rows merged and checked as one film), `--scene <name|n>` / `--scenes` (the entry's `sections`, which `timeline().check` carries, or its `scenes` cuts numbered from 1), `--every N` (layout rules only), `--untracked error`, `--occupancy [share]`, `--no-media`, `--paced` (wait two animation frames per frame instead of flushing React synchronously). On a page crash it prints the console tail and the frame it died on.
- `romp check --audio <file.wav> [--json]`: the dropout check alone.
- `romp check --lottie <anim.json> [--layers a,b] [--from s] [--to s] [--json]`: plays a Lottie export with lottie-web (installed in your project) in headless Chromium and checks every layer.
- `romp sound <module.ts> --out file.wav [--arg json] [--lufs -16]`: renders a module's `render(arg)` in headless Chromium and loudness-normalises it.
